app_function_edges.py._note: @app.function helper + with app.setup: the control-upstream-impact hit proves dependency edges flow through the helper cell (summary above the control reads kept_orders, which the helper derives from cutoff.value).

eda_dependent_chain.py._note: Dependent control chain (city options derive from country.value) is exempt from ui-split-cells.

eda_far_consumer.py._note: Slider defined 3 visible cells before first use; in-between cells are narrative-only so control-zone-gap stays quiet in report mode.

generic_exports.py._note: Cell exports generic names result/chart; message must not mention underscore prefixing.

report_gap.py._note: Unrelated visible cell between the control and its dependent cell breaks the zone.

report_global_filter.py._note: Document-wide filter: every later visible cell is affected or narrative, so no zone gap.

report_good_zone.py._note: Summary does not depend on the control; control is followed directly by its dependent cell; narrative and new section come after the zone.

report_hstack_display.py._note: Control displayed in the same mo.hstack as its chart; no ui-far-consumer in eda, no gap in report.

report_summary_depends_on_control.py._note: Visible summary above the control reads a value derived from control.value.

report_tabs_and_crossfilter.py._note: mo.ui.tabs is layout (not a control); the altair_chart selection feeds the immediately following cell.
